# Task 18: the field route for the video run (KHNMC_CLOCK=frames, any backend).  Same route as runtime/task6-field-input.txt
# (accept the settings, New Game, Standard Mode, through to the first field), then battle input.
# Differences from task6: (1) no press at script frame 90: that press only did nothing because the Initial Settings page used to come
# up after present 92; on the frames clock boot presents are fewer (page at present 56 in a null-backend run) and the press opened the
# confirm dialog early, the route then looped in the settings menu.  (2) from script frame 2800 on: attack every 20 game frames,
# lock-on every 300, a jump every 400, the reaction command between attacks.  The field comes up near script frame 2700..2850.
